strategies.name: kg
strategies.label: Evidence graph
strategies.summary: Quote-backed findings per paper, joined into a knowledge graph; the entry is written from the graph.

strategies.name: direct
strategies.label: Direct reading
strategies.summary: All papers in one prompt; the model writes the entry straight from the text.

strategies.name: cohort
strategies.label: Case table first
strategies.summary: One structured record per reported patient or family, pooled into a case table; the entry is rendered from it.

strategies.name: kg_matched
strategies.label: Evidence graph, matched
strategies.summary: Evidence graph with extraction at the writer's effort and synopsis terms chosen by the writer, not by rule.

strategies.name: kg_hybrid
strategies.label: Evidence graph plus text
strategies.summary: As the matched evidence graph, and the writer also reads the papers' text.

strategies.name: cohort_matched
strategies.label: Case table, matched
strategies.summary: Case table with extraction at the writer's effort and synopsis terms and inheritance chosen by the writer.

strategies.name: cohort_hybrid
strategies.label: Case table plus text
strategies.summary: As the matched case table, and the writer also reads the papers' text.
